name: Cursed Razor Plague (Combat)
body:
Your curses spread amongst your enemies.

Prerequisites: Cursed Razor Style, Spellcraft 7 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you cause an opponent to become cursed by an effect other than this feat, you may select an additional opponent within 30 feet of you to become cursed for the same duration. This only gives that opponent the cursed condition; it does not inflict any other effects from the first curse. This is a supernatural ability.
